fault_reset._source: A6-EC manual chapter 10 fault table (docs/drives/a6ec/a6ec_manual_codes.json, the same table compiled into native alarm names): every fault code the vendor marks resettable, matched by its exact 0x603F bus code and 0x203F fault code. Owner decision 2026-10-11 after a Rosie 1430 arm's J5 Er41.1 (12:19, mechanical stall; rt-core refused Reset for over 2 h with fault_persists): an operator Reset sends the drive its own CiA402 fault reset (controlword bit 7 rising edge) for these alarms only. A code absent here, or a fault whose 0x203F detail is unread, is not resettable. The manual's class column (Class 1/2) appears beside both resettable and non-resettable codes and is not a reset criterion. rt-core/docs/CONTRACTS.md 'Operator reset of resettable drive alarms'.
fault_reset._unverified: leave_fault_ms 200: unverified bound for the drive to leave Fault after the edge (CiA402 transition 15), chosen inside the adapter's 1 s recovery observation; the A6-EC time is not measured. min_interval_ms 1000: unverified, owner-requested rate limit between reset attempts on one axis. Measure the leave-Fault time on a Rosie 1430 arm's first reset (journal drive_alarm_reset lines) and record it here.

not_reset.reason: Reserved in the manual, with no 0x603F bus code: it cannot be matched exactly, so it is not classified.
Home position setting error concerns the drive-owned Home (607C) and HM35: it stays as before and is cleared at the drive by the HM35 procedure, never by a reset.
Multi-turn overflow is a position-reference fault (0x603F 0x7305, the encoder code): reference loss stays as before, Home is re-established by HM35 at the mechanical home pose, never by a reset.

ethercat._tx_layout_source: The nine-motor bench's servo host, read-only SDO survey 2026-09-14, CoE 22033/22034: fixed TxPDO 0x1B04 adds signed 32-bit 0x606C velocity_actual and 0x60F4 following_error, and drops 0x60FD digital inputs. On the nine-motor bench's servo host on 2026-09-15, physical PREOP readback verified the 0x1B04 assignment for all nine AS715N axes on the first attempt; the nine scanned-cache misses were resolved by the daemon's automatic rescan, with no mailbox retry during the mapping hand-off (docs/evidence/bench-ninemotor-2026-09-15/daemon-8deed804-b04.log:234-347,584-592); the kernel log contained neither 'wrong SDO' nor 'SDO configuration failed' (docs/evidence/bench-ninemotor-2026-09-15/dmesg-ethercat-8deed804-b04.txt:1-60). Owner decision 2026-09-15: 0x1B04 is the bench and robot default at 1000000 ns cycles; select a6ec_1b02 when wired drive digital inputs must be cyclic. Drive inputs on 0x1B04 are mailbox display observations; safety reactions belong to the hardware stop chain and cyclic cell I/O (P6-05). A6-EC manual chapter 11 (docs/drives/a6ec/a6ec_manual_chapter_11_parameter_list.md): 0x606C reference unit/s and 0x60F4 reference unit, i.e. counts/s and counts in the drive position frame; diagnostic observations only, never speed-safety certification.

coordinate_evidence._mode_contract: Owner decision 2026-10-19: C00.07=1 linear absolute mode, continuous 6064/607A and exact whole-count coordinate evidence. Rotation and batteryless single-turn modes are retired.
coordinate_evidence._encoder_loss_signals: The listed 0x2040 absolute_feedback subentries expose positions only; no encoder-loss validity signal is available in this readback. In both evidence modes, statusword 0x6041 fault bit 3 and any nonzero error code 0x603F make readiness faulted without themselves invalidating coordinates or Home. The encoder-specific error code 0x7305 additionally invalidates coordinates and Home (GradientOS docs/resources/a6ec_manual_codes.md, A6-EC fault table: Encoder error). PDO discontinuity and contradictory encoder evidence still invalidate independently.
coordinate_evidence._anchor_tolerance_unverified: Unverified power-cycle and homing origin retention. Restore only when the continuous encoder and native PDO agree with the saved exact counts within 16 counts. A whole-turn or origin change fails closed.
coordinate_evidence._unverified: Unverified physical speed 5000000 counts/s, including unpowered backdrive. Count tolerance 16 retains margin over the measured 2-count resting spread in registers-1.log. Qualify exact continuous evidence across the full travel on every drive.
coordinate_evidence.maximum_physical_speed_counts_per_second: Unverified bound on hand-turn or backdrive motion during inhibited continuous-source acquisition. Powered 0x607F uses the cell drive_speed_limit_motor_rpm and 131072 motor counts/rev independently.
coordinate_evidence.start_alignment_floor_counts_source: The former native 50-count independent-encoder Start floor (kIndependentEncoderStartAlignmentFloorCounts), moved to configuration unchanged. Unverified.
coordinate_evidence._source: Owner-selected linear-mode source 2026-10-19: raw signed64 U40.20/.22 (0x2040:21/23), bracketed high/low/high to reject tearing; anchor identity version 3 fences prior modes.
coordinate_evidence._acquisition_unverified: The nine-motor bench's servo host, sampled-412be4dd.log, 2026-09-13: measured two-upload acquisitions 56000000..83094896 ns (about 83 ms), uploads 24000000..44000000 ns, 0.60..0.67 samples/s/axis. Unverified bracketed acquisition_max = ceil((83094896 + 44000000)/1000000)*1000000 = 128000000 ns. Required age >= interval + N * acquisition_max + diagnostics + margin: 3000000000 = 1500000000 + 9 * 128000000 + 44000000 + 304000000 ns. Diagnostics and arbitration allocations remain unverified under contention. Checkpointed foreign uploads are outside this baseline sum: native-home truth refresh adds up to 9 * 44000000 ns, and startup and mapping readbacks can each insert an upload between sample opportunities. A refresh burst reaches 1500000000 + 9 * 128000000 + 9 * 44000000 + 44000000 = 3092000000 ns before margin; grace covers the resulting transient inhibit for idle axes without a fault if coherent recovery arrives within the bound. start_gap_ns and maximum_start_gap_ns publish sampling pauses. PDO history has ceil(age/cycle)+2 entries; PDO age remains one cycle. Missing, Unavailable, Cadence and Torn publications cannot replace retained valid evidence or renew its age. Sound Cadence/Stale samples with retained PDO history and bounded low-word skew are checked for contradictions in the receiving cycle. For multi_turn only, after age expiry inhibit the affected axis with coordinate_invalid readiness and preserve Home for two sample cadences = 3000000000 ns; coherent recovery restores idle-axis readiness, longer absence or contradictory evidence latches the coordinate fault and requires rehome. Grace writes controlword 0; a moving axis fails closed with FaultDriveReadiness next cycle when the drive leaves enabled. Qualify bracket acquisitions, gaps and recovery on all nine axes.
